sources.panel_size: User Guide - PRIME 4, PRIME 4+, PRIME 2, PRIME GO, PRIME GO+, SC LIVE 4, SC LIVE 2 v5.3.0, Technical Specifications, PRIME 4 / PRIME 4+, Dimensions (728.47 x 496.82 x 103.63 mm)
sources.wire: PLACEHOLDER wires on channel 16 (apps/webui/frontend/src/lib/rb/midi/maps/denon-prime4-plus.ts hints): Denon DJ publishes no MIDI message list for the PRIME 4+
sources.positions: measured trace of the official top-panel figure (vector paths of the user guide, page 6), normalised for the renderer; reference: devices/denon-prime4-plus/panel.reference.json (ADR-0137)

out_of_scope: every wire identity: no published MIDI list, so every control is a map hint (inert) until one exists
touchscreen, platter displays, FX OLED displays, channel and master level meters: displays, not controls
SD card slot and USB 1/2 ports: media slots on the top panel, not controls
front-panel and rear-panel controls (mic inputs, headphone jacks, zone and booth outputs)
pad modes other than the mode button pressed: pads carry one placeholder wire each
